title: fix(post): keep decimal points in Fanuc-family feed words
body:
## What changed

Keep decimal points in Fanuc, Doosan DNM and Mazak feed words.
Keep them on the separate capped rotary feeds in Fanuc and Doosan DNM.
Keep the existing conversion, precision, rounding and rate limits.

Record the manual audit for all 17 posts in [the decision record](https://github.com/mkinney/Camcraft/blob/9c3d2888e36611daea6f02720cf79d3c440350bf/docs/decisions/3690-feed-decimals.md).
Update exact test expectations and regenerate the affected NC programs.

## Cause

The formatters removed the decimal point from whole feeds.
A request for 2 inch/min became F2.
The cited controls can read that unpointed word as 0.02 inch/min.
An explicit point makes the unit clear.

## Tests

Committed head: 9c3d2888e36611daea6f02720cf79d3c440350bf.
Full verification started from upstream main 7868d378680b325246b0dcdcdbf76c421f801cd9.
The checks cover the committed source and NC programs.
The decision record was added after verification.

Pin command: `cargo test -p camcraft-post --test control_feed_decimal_point -- --nocapture`.
All five pins failed on unchanged production code.
All five passed with the fix.

- `fanuc_whole_inch_feeds_keep_their_decimal_point`
- `doosan_whole_inch_feeds_keep_their_decimal_point`
- `mazak_whole_inch_feeds_keep_their_decimal_point`
- `fanuc_capped_inch_feed_keeps_its_decimal_point`
- `doosan_capped_inch_feed_keeps_its_decimal_point`

Mutation results:

- Restore the full old Fanuc script: ordinary and capped pins fail. Restore the fix: both pass.
- Restore the full old Doosan script: ordinary and capped pins fail. Restore the fix: both pass.
- Restore the full old Mazak script: the ordinary pin fails. Restore the fix: it passes.
- Remove only the Fanuc capped point, with its ordinary formatter fixed: the capped pin fails. Restore: it passes.
- Remove only the Doosan capped point, with its ordinary formatter fixed: the capped pin fails. Restore: it passes.

Seven pin results proved red without the relevant fix and green after the restore.

Final gate coverage:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 836 steps. 835 passed. One catalog assertion still expected F80.
- Update that expected word to F80. `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --failed gate-logs/quick-20261123-220356`: one selected step passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --only "app suites: example_catalog"`: final artifact check passed. 39 tests passed; 4 were ignored.
- The quick run also passed `example_catalog_adaptive` and `example_catalog_edge_work`: one test each.
- The quick UI library step passed 1,529 tests; 8 were ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: 62 steps. 61 passed. The catalog step found two stale programs in its ignored cases.
- Regenerate slots and adaptive-pocket. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --failed gate-logs/heavy-20261123-225913`: all 3 selected steps passed.
- That retry passed all 4 ignored catalog tests and both expected known-fail checks. The other 61 heavy steps passed unchanged.
- The heavy planner skipped 42 steps outside this diff's reach. These are not passes.
- `git diff --check`: passed.

The final coverage has no unresolved failure.
Expected text and golden updates explain the initial red steps.
One cache-enabled prebuild run waited after compilation, as in #3675. Only that gate session was interrupted.
Retries used forced Cargo environment settings for the wrapper and target seed.
Missing local build artifacts required package cleanup in this worktree. No shared cache service stopped.

New test binary: No feed-format directory suite exists.
The cross-post decimal pins use a separate binary with a Gate map for the three changed posts.

## Goldens moved

97 NC programs changed. Each row below has the same reason: add decimal points to integer F words to make their units explicit.
Each program was regenerated with repository tools.
An independent check read each file's git diff and compared its complete bytes.
The only changes add 27,691 F decimal points.
No coordinate, other value, CL file or saved project changed.
Generated project migrations were discarded.

Regeneration used the existing WRITE_GOLDEN test hooks, `cargo xtask catalog --case <case>`, `camcraft-cli process`, and the `post` CLI.
The catalog cases were edge-work, contour-tabs, first-part, hole-work, slots, adaptive-pocket, indexed, probe-face and rough-finish.

The control format findings use the cited public manuals.
Some unchanged dialect findings are explicit inferences; the decision record names their limits.
Fractional feed precision and tapping precision are outside this fix.
No UI code changed, so screenshots do not apply.
Main advanced to 074c23ba675c2db3195ca3728155841d6b4e3c06 during verification.
No file in this PR overlaps that update.
The branch was not refreshed with those later, unrelated changes.

## Overlaps

None. Per-file checks found no open PR that changes the touched paths.

Effort: high

Changelog: Preserve decimal points in Fanuc, Doosan DNM and Mazak feed words to prevent integer feed scaling.

Fixes #3690
